objective: Bind formal evidence to the exact Coordinator task revision and reject stale evidence at lifecycle boundaries.
assumptions: Coordinator task front matter is the lifecycle authority
Evidence artifacts are public-safe references and digests
Formal checking remains offline and bounded
unknowns: Future Coordinator event transports may carry the same envelope through another adapter
invariants: Evidence task identity and revision equal Coordinator state
Formal-check identity and digest equal the referenced specification
Stale evidence cannot become valid without a new check
Evidence class is explicit and cannot be inferred from oracle approval
acceptance_predicates: The checker reports stale rather than silently accepting evidence

formalization.scope: one task revision and one evidence envelope
